description: This file defines API routes for user management within a FastAPI application. It includes functionalities such as creating, listing, fetching, updating, deleting users, assigning/removing roles, and resetting passwords, all scoped to an organization and secured with permission dependencies.

classes.name: UserUpdate
classes.description: Payload model for updating user details (excluding password).

classes.name: PasswordReset
classes.description: Payload model for resetting a user's password.

methods.name: get_db()
methods.description: Creates a new database session using the SessionLocal factory, providing it as a dependency.

methods.name: None _audit(db: Session, org_id: int, user_id: Optional[int], action: str, resource_type: str, resource_id: Optional[str], details: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Logs an audit event into the audit log database table.

methods.name: UserOut create_user( payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Creates a new user within the current user's organization, enforcing permission checks and preventing cross-org operations.

methods.name: List[UserOut] list_users( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:read")), )
methods.description: Returns a list of users within the current user's organization.

methods.name: UserOut get_user( user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:read")), )
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID, constrained to the caller's organization.

methods.name: UserOut update_user( updates: UserUpdate, user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Updates user details such as full name and active status within the caller's organization.

methods.name: None delete_user( user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Deletes a user and associated roles within the caller's organization.

methods.name: UserOut assign_role_to_user( user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user within the same organization, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: UserOut remove_role_from_user( user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), role_id: int = Path(..., description="Role ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Removes a role from a user within the same organization.

methods.name: UserOut reset_user_password( payload: PasswordReset, user_id: int = Path(..., description="User ID"), db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), _: None = Depends(require_permission("users:write")), )
methods.description: Resets a user's password after verifying organization scope.
